title: Linseywoolsey
html_source:
Linsey-woolsey is a plainwoven fabric with linen/cotton warp and wool weft, a textile known since ancient times and forbidden to be warn under Jewish law.

Either from linen + wool, or from linsey, originally denoting a coarse linen fabric (probably from Lindsey, a village in Suffolk, England, where the material was first made) + wool
